Method of Attack: Targets Linux systems to identify and terminate processes of other cryptominers
Deletes binaries of other cryptominers to prevent revival
Kills processes consuming 60% or more CPU with names resembling legitimate Linux processes
Exploits Apache Struts CVE-2018-11776 vulnerability to inject OGNL expressions executing shell commands to download and run malicious files
Uses Cron for persistence and Xhide to launch executables with fake process names
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Apache Struts CVE-2018-11776 vulnerability via HTTP request with OGNL injection in URL
Indicators of Compromise: Injection of OGNL expressions in URL
HTTP request containing shell commands to download and execute malicious files
